properties.description: Nine real-binary tests with an isolated HOME and a per-run deadline: every store-opening mode in a pointer folder (read, write, no-design and design-making tools) refuses naming the design id and address and leaves the folder byte-for-byte as it was; a store left beside a pointer is neither opened nor written; in an empty folder a read refuses and creates nothing while a write creates; an opted-in folder reads as its empty design; --only-if-present; --read-only with a graph write, export_graph/export_surface writing a file (new and existing with overwrite), reads still answering, and --import; --export-to and --remote with --call; and the walk of every flag --help lists against all eleven one-shot modes.
properties.name: every_one_shot_mode_resolves_its_design_first.rs — the real binary in real folders, and every --help flag against every one-shot mode
